overview: Apple Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables, and accessories, while also selling related services. The Company’s important product lines include iPhone (such as iPhone Duo™, iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max), Mac (including MacBook Neo®, MacBook Air®, MacBook Pro®, iMac®, Mac mini®, Mac Studio®), iPad (iPad Pro®, iPad Air®, iPad, iPad mini®), wearables (Apple Watch Series 12®, Apple Watch Ultra 4®, AirPods®, AirPods Pro®, AirPods Max®, Beats®), Apple Vision Pro® (spatial computer), and Apple TV 4K® (media streaming and gaming device) [10-K accession 0000320193-26-000026, lines L000851-L000915]. These devices run the Company’s proprietary operating systems iOS, macOS, iPadOS, watchOS, visionOS, and tvOS, delivering seamless integration and enabling services such as the App Store, Apple Music, Apple Pay, iCloud, and Apple TV [EX-99.1 accession 0000320193-26-000024, line L000019]. The Company’s fiscal year ends on the last Saturday of September [10-K accession 0000320193-26-000026, line L000853].
market_positioning_and_growth_outlook: Apple holds a leading position in personal technology innovation with a diversified portfolio of hardware and integrated software platforms that create high switching costs and a strong ecosystem. The Company highlights the iPhone Duo as “the most transformational iPhone since the original,” alongside the powerful new iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max models [EX-99.1 accession 0000320193-26-000024, line L000013]. Apple’s installed base of active devices reached a new all-time high across all product categories [EX-99.1 accession 0000320193-26-000024, line L000014]. Growth is supported by revenue increases across Americas, Europe, Greater China, Japan, and Rest of Asia Pacific, driven mainly by higher iPhone, Services, and Mac net sales [10-K accession 0000320193-26-000026, lines L001238-L001253]. iPhone net sales rose 21% to $254.1 billion in fiscal 2026, fueled by new and refreshed models [10-K accession 0000320193-26-000026, line L001258]. Services net sales, including advertising and cloud, grew 13% to $123.3 billion and reached an all-time high in the September quarter [10-K accession 0000320193-26-000026, line L001262; EX-99.1 accession 0000320193-26-000024, line L000009]. Mac sales increased 13%, while iPad net sales remained relatively flat [10-K accession 0000320193-26-000026, lines L001259-L001260]. The Company faces macroeconomic challenges such as inflation, tariffs, supply constraints in key components, and currency fluctuations, which have increased costs and could impact demand [10-K accession 0000320193-26-000026, lines L001230-L001231, L001234].
future_developments_and_strategic_recomm: Apple increased its research and development expense significantly, spending $45.8 billion in fiscal 2026 compared to $34.6 billion in 2025, signaling a strong commitment to expanding its product pipeline and innovation capabilities [EX-99.1 accession 0000320193-26-000024, line L000047]. Major product launches in fiscal 2026 included new iPhone models (iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro/Max), MacBook Neo, MacBook Air, MacBook Pro refreshes, AirPods Max 2, Apple Vision Pro, and new software releases like iOS 27 and macOS 27 [10-K accession 0000320193-26-000026, lines L001198-L001228]. Management should closely monitor the impact of tariffs and supply constraints, particularly for advanced semiconductors, memory, and storage, to manage risks on margins and volume [10-K accession 0000320193-26-000026, lines L001230-L001231]. Additionally, strengthening the high-margin, recurring revenue Services segment will be critical to maintaining Apple’s competitive moat. Continued hardware innovation alongside expansion of Services, as well as attention to currency and geopolitical trade conditions, will be essential for sustaining growth and profitability.
insight: Insight: Apple’s intangible assets, net, increased substantially from $11.1 billion in 2025 to $20.3 billion in 2026, reflecting a strategic emphasis on intellectual property and software development investments that support future growth [10-K accession 0000320193-26-000026, line L000091].

source.quote: The Company’s fiscal year is the 52- or 53-week period that ends on the last Saturday of September.
The Company posted quarterly revenue of $114.5 billion, up 12 percent year over year.
Diluted earnings per share was $2.10, up 14 percent year over year.
